newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Mandela to join Bangladesh independence celebration.
newsitem.headline: Mandela to join Bangladesh independence celebration.

text.p: South African President Nelson Mandela, Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and Turkish President Suleyman Demirel will attend Bangladesh's silver jubilee celebrations on March 26, the foreign ministry said on Saturday.

They said all three leaders were due to arrive in Dhaka on March 25 at the invitation of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, daughter of Bangladesh's independence leader Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, who was killed in a 1975 army coup.
Mujib led Bangladesh to independence from Pakistan in 1971. His daughter took power 21 years after his death following victory of his Awami League in a general election last June.
Mandela and Hasina might take time out from the ceremonies to discuss economic cooperation.
"Dhaka is very eager to boost trade with Pretoria," one official said. There is vast scope to expand bilateral trade."
Mandela is expected to leave Dhaka on March 27 for the Indian capital New Delhi.

Hasina and Demirel will meet briefly to discuss bilateral economic cooperation and review the progress of a proposed trade bloc of eight Moslem countries, the officials said. Arafat's itinerary is still being worked out, they added.
